_doc: skin.json for the feature-walkthrough template: a POINTER, not a skin. new-film writes `skin` into film.json "skin"; build_film.py
then runs tools/skin_apply.py (scenes/skin_data.js + design.md tokens) before the lint and the render.
Meridian Dark: charcoal ground, electric-teal accent, medium motion profile, broadcast captions - developer and platform demos.
Mint Ledger is the light alternative (typewriter captions, calm) for ledger/audit features read in a bright room.
head_fade: the scene's #black plate reads var(--black) from the skin: dark skins open from near-black, light skins from their own paper
